text: emmeline: Hey team — new chart mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — thinking about how we surface units and outliers in the legend for the Console metrics dashboard. Two problems: 1) legends are long when we include full units like "requests/sec" and 2) screen readers read a wall of text. Thoughts? sam_k: can we compact units? e.g., show short unit in legend ("/s") and full text on hover tooltip? :thinking: junaid: I worry about collapsing too much — a lot of stable customers rely on seeing the exact unit at-a-glance. maria_p: Agree with Junaid. Maybe abbreviation + an accessible label for SRs: visually "/s" but aria-label="requests per second". a11y_bot: a11y note: avoid relying on hover for essential info. Tooltips are inaccessible to keyboard-only users. Recommend visible short form + persistent sr-only text or an aria-describedby anchor. leo: For outliers, can we annotate points with a small icon and include an "outlier policy" line in legend? e.g., little chevron + tooltip "outlier clipped at 99.9th percentile". Keyboard focus should land on the point and announce it. emmeline: Nice. Proposal: legend shows short unit + inline — example: "Latency (ms)" becomes "Latency (ms)" but we display "ms" as compact. On screen-readers: aria-label="Latency in milliseconds". For long series names we wrap and allow vertical scroll in legend panel. sam_k: CSS snippet that keeps legend compact but still tabbable: ```:css .legend-item { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; } .unit { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); } .legend-item:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); } ``` junaid: About smoothing: if we apply moving-average we should show a tiny "sm" badge in legend and make smoothing reversible per-chart. Also annotate raw vs smoothed in tooltip. maria_p: Copy tweak: replace "units" label with "Unit" singular — matches other places in Console. a11y_bot: Keyboard flow: when legend item receives focus, SR should announce "Series name, unit, currently visible, smoothing on/off, outliers clipped at X". Use aria-live polite region for toggles. leo: One more: for density charts with many tiny series, offer a compact mode that collapses unit to a header row and shows series names indented. emmeline: Solid. Action items: - Junaid: add sm badge + tooltip text and a toggle in the legend - Sam: implement accessible legend keyboard states + CSS - Maria: update copy (Unit vs Units) and microcopy for outlier tooltip - Leo: prototype compact mode for dense charts - A11y: provide aria pattern snippet for SR announcement maria_p: I'll open a PR with copy changes. junaid: I'll mock the sm badge and tooltip in the figma link tonight. a11y_bot: Suggestion snippet for aria announcement: `Latency in milliseconds. Smoothing: on. Outliers clipped at 99.9th percentile.` emmeline: Thanks all — will sync tomorrow in 11:00 design review. :sparkles:
